definitions.content: A device which contains all the necessary information and receives all the necessary signals from the measuring device to enable it to calculate the volume or other associated quantities. It may also store information, provide checking facilities for the information and communicate with auxiliary devices.
Dispositif qui contient toutes les informations nécessaires et reçoit tous les signaux nécessaires du dispositif de mesure lui permettant de calculer le volume ou d'autres grandeurs associées.
